title: Automate changelog and onboard orion-alpha-13b v1.1 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Add Orion Alpha v1.1 to the model registry with full metadata, curated performance profiles for common seq-len buckets, and wire up automated changelog/release-note generation so downstream consumers (Redwood Console, release feeds, and SDK docs) get consistent release notes. This PR implements: 1) model metadata entry (model card, canonical tags, tokenizer info), 2) performance profiles for 256/512/1024 token windows measured on our NVLink cluster, 3) an automated changelog generator that consumes git commit metadata + profile diffs to produce release notes, and 4) small docs updates and examples for how to pin the v1.1 variant. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata JSON and model card - [x] Add perf profile JSONs for 256/512/1024 - [x] Add automation hook (changelog generator config) - [x] Update onboarding scripts to include validation step on dedicated infra - [x] Add lightweight example in registry README - [x] Run CI profile validation and unit tests Implementation details: - metadata/registry/orion-alpha/metadata-v1.1.json: contains model_name, architecture, tokenizer, default_max_seq, quantization_compat (int8/4bit notes), and recommended deployment tiers (hosted/dedicated). - perf-profiles/orion-alpha/v1.1/{256,512,1024}.json: throughput and p50/p95 latency measured on c5xlarge-like and p4d configs; profile includes notes about KV cache behavior for streaming workloads. - scripts/changelog-generator/config.yaml: config for automated release note extraction; maps model-registry tags to release channels and includes templated sections for PERF and METADATA changes. - registry-onboard/orion-alpha/v1.1/onboard.sh: idempotent onboarding script used by CI to validate bundle and push metadata to the canonical registry. Backwards compatibility: v1.1 is a minor perf/config update; model artifacts identical to v1.0. Automation: changelog generator will include a "Perf profile updates" section when perf-profiles/* has non-empty diffs compared to the previous tagged version. Rollout: will be available in hosted catalog and flagged for dedicated customers as opt-in for 48 hours before becoming generally available. Testing: included unit tests for changelog parser and integration test that runs onboarding script in a container with mocked registry endpoint. Notes: CI initially hit a flaky benchmark collection on the first run (transient GPU mount error) which was retried automatically by the runner and passed. Related: ENG-4128 (perf onboarding), PM-2291 (catalog release coordination), SUP-982 (support ticket to validate deployment on dedicated).
commits: Add metadata JSON and model card for orion-alpha v1.1
Add perf profiles for 256/512/1024 token windows
Add onboarding script and integration tests
Docs: registry README example and release note snippet
